newsitem.title: USA: Flagstar completes $55 mln sale of unit.
newsitem.headline: Flagstar completes $55 mln sale of unit.

text.p: Flagstar Companies Inc said on Monday it completed the sale of its food processing subsidiary, Portion-Trol Foods Inc, to Simus Foods International for a total purchase price of $55 million.
The transaction was financed by a group of venture capitalists led by Dallas-based MESBIC Ventures Holding Co.
The investor group also includes Opportunity Capital and Connecticut-Greene Ventures.
Dumas Simus will serve as chairman and chief executive officer of the newly acquired business, it said.
